Post 1

📉 ASX 200 slipped 66.80pts (-0.77%) to 8,660.90, crossing below its 20-day MA. Materials dragged hardest. Five-day gain of 0.54% now at risk. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials worst sector at -2.03%. Consumer Staples led gains at +1.42%, Energy +1.36%, Utilities +1.34%. Defensives caught bids while cyclicals sold off. #ASX #mining #energy

Post 3

🔻 LOV cratered 9.15% to AUD 22.44 — the sharpest blue-chip fall of the session. Discretionary held +0.31% overall, so this was stock-specific pain, not sector rot. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,952.38/oz, Silver AUD 85.16/oz. AUD/USD 0.6956. Metals priced richly in local terms, yet Materials fell 2.03% — a disconnect worth watching. #gold #silver #ASX

Post 5

Materials -2.03% despite firm AUD gold. If that gap closes tomorrow, does gold lift miners or do miners drag gold stocks lower? Index near 8,660 — hold or break? Your call. #ASX #ausbiz
